proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of any part numbers, VIN tags, or markings on the catalytic converter and manifold.
Photo of the part installed on a Lexus GS460 2017 to confirm fitment.
Photo of the damaged area on the catalytic converter to assess severity.
Documentation or proof of origin (e.g., salvage yard receipt, vehicle registration).
response.reason: The seller claims the part is for a Lexus GS460 2017, but no identifying marks are visible in the photo. The part appears damaged, and without proof of origin or fitment, it cannot be priced accurately. More evidence is needed to verify identity, condition, and compatibility.
